entities.name: Cisco
entities.gloss: An American multinational digital communications and networking hardware and software company.

entities.name: Cisco Discovery Protocol
entities.gloss: A proprietary Data Link Layer network protocol used by Cisco devices to share information with directly connected devices.

entities.name: CDPwn
entities.gloss: A collective name for five critical vulnerabilities found in the Cisco Discovery Protocol implementation.

entities.name: CVE-2020-3120
entities.gloss: A denial-of-service and memory exhaustion vulnerability affecting Cisco FXOS, IOS XR, and NX-OS implementations of CDP.

entities.name: Cisco FXOS
entities.gloss: An operating system developed by Cisco for its Firepower series security appliances.

entities.name: Cisco IOS XR
entities.gloss: A train of Cisco Systems' network operating systems designed for service provider routers.

entities.name: Cisco NX-OS
entities.gloss: A network operating system for the Cisco Nexus-series Ethernet switches and Cisco MDS 9000-series storage networking switches.

entities.name: CVE-2020-3119
entities.gloss: A stack overflow vulnerability in Cisco NX-OS CDP implementation allowing remote administrative code execution.

entities.name: CVE-2020-3118
entities.gloss: A stack overflow vulnerability in Cisco IOS XR CDP implementation allowing remote administrative code execution.

entities.name: CVE-2020-3111
entities.gloss: A vulnerability in Cisco IP Phone CDP implementation allowing remote code execution with root privileges or device reload.

entities.name: IP-телефон Cisco IP
entities.gloss: A line of voice-over-IP telephone devices manufactured by Cisco Systems.

entities.name: CVE-2020-3110
entities.gloss: A vulnerability in Cisco 8000 Series IP Cameras CDP implementation allowing remote code execution or denial of service.

entities.name: IP-камери Cisco для відеоспостереження серії 8000
entities.gloss: A series of high-definition video surveillance IP cameras manufactured by Cisco Systems.
